chunks: From him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: concerning
A man who married off his female slave to another man, then had intercourse with her—he said: "He is to be given the hadd punishment."

key_terms.يُضْرَبُ: he is to be struck or subjected to

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man marries his female slave to someone else and then has intercourse with her?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a man who marries his female slave to another man and then has intercourse with her himself. Imam Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that the hadd punishment is to be carried out, showing the legal seriousness of violating the marital bond established for her.
